entities.name: Lucius Roscius Aelianus Maecius Celer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Lucius Roscius Aelianus Maecius Celer was a Roman senator of the second century AD, suffect consul from November-December AD 100 with Tiberius Claudius Sacerdos Julianus.

    He played a crucial role in the governance of Rome, working closely with the Roman Senate and implementing policies that benefited the Roman Empire.

    Celer's legacy can be seen in the many inscriptions and records that have survived to this day, providing valuable insights into the life and career of this important Roman statesman.

    Despite his significant contributions, little is known about Celer's personal life, leaving historians to speculate about his family, social status, and ultimate fate.
